# Logo.dev

Logo.dev provides a high-quality logo API and company brand database, enabling developers to retrieve official high-resolution logos from any domain without scraping or manual effort.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/logo-dev/.

## Actions

- **Get Logo Image** (read-only): Retrieve the logo image for a domain.
- **Search Brand** (read-only): Search for brands based on a query string.
